text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Forgive me, Trainer. This injury is of my own wrongdoing…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Of course, this is but a trifle. It is nowhere near capable of halting my advance.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: However… I have let you become enshrouded with a gloom.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I, who have sworn to bring light to all, have cast a shadow on your heart—you, the person closest to me!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Allow me to help you! My stride is still strong, this injury notwithstanding!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I will bring peace to your troubled heart—you have my word!
choice_data_list: Sounds good. Let's take a break then.
Sounds good. Let's take a break then.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I will bring peace to your troubled heart—you have my word!
choice_data_list: Sounds good. Let's take a break then.
Sounds good. Let's take a break then.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: H-have you not been listening?! In order to put you at ease, I…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Aha! I see what you're implying.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You wish to become my sanctuary. It would bring you the highest of joys… Yes?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: It vexes me to take a pause in our onward march, but this, too, is my royal duty.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O seems to realize how much is riding on her shoulders and takes a rest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's right about me being worried. I can only rest assured if she's in good condition!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Excellent! Now, let us venture outdoors where we—

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: THE PAIN!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Heh… Hehehe… I-it seems the gods… are more jealous of you than… I had imagined…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: This guilt… is too much… to bear! Collapse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She must have committed another wrongdoing somehow. I rush over to help her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's right about me being worried. I can only rest assured if she's in good condition!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Excellent! Now, let us venture outdoors…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Phew… Well? What did you think of my stride? Not a notch shy of brilliant, yes?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh, as I thought! Your feelings come through loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: By the sight of my run, you have been moved to your core. Filled with joy, you are at the brink of tears!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: There is no need for gratitude! As I said, I already know your feelings.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yes! There, in your smile!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There are a few things I could say to her, perhaps to curb her vanity. But I suppose I can be content that she's healthy and in good spirits.
